instruction: Move the text placeholder on Page 3 to the top of the slide, just below the title.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the text placeholder on slide 3 to the top position, just below the title. The metric dynamically finds the text placeholder shape (verifying it has a text frame and is a PLACEHOLDER or TEXT_BOX type) rather than assuming a fixed index. The title ends at approximately 1417320 EMUs, so 'just below' means the text placeholder should be positioned between 1467320 (title bottom + 50000 EMUs) and 1667320 (title bottom + 250000 EMUs), providing a reasonable 200000 EMU range (~7mm) for 'just below' positioning.
